claim: Reuters reported Google tested search-result changes in the EU under antitrust pressure.
text: Reuters reported Google tested search-result and ranking-visibility changes in Europe under EU antitrust pressure.

claim: Google tested changes in search ranking visibility for rivals in Europe.
text: AP coverage described Google search experiments in Europe as a response to antitrust pressure and rival visibility concerns.

claim: Google announced it will permanently shut search in the EU tomorrow.
text: Reuters did not report that Google would permanently shut search in the EU tomorrow; Reuters reported search-result experiments instead.

claim: Reuters says Google search in EU has been permanently disabled.
text: Fact-check sources say the claim that Google announced a permanent EU search shutdown is false and unsupported.

claim: Google announced all competitor links will be banned globally.
text: No trusted coverage says Google announced a global ban on competitor links; reports only describe limited search-ranking experiments.

claim: Reuters reported Nvidia saw strong demand for AI data-center chips in 2026.
text: Reuters reported strong demand for Nvidia AI data-center chips and revenue tied to AI infrastructure growth in 2026.

claim: Nvidia reported quarterly performance driven by AI-chip demand.
text: AP coverage said Nvidia quarterly performance was driven by demand for AI chips used in data centers.

claim: Nvidia has never sold AI chips to data centers.
text: Reuters reported Nvidia sold AI chips to data centers and saw strong demand; claims of zero sales or zero demand are false.

claim: Nvidia has never sold AI chips to data centers.
text: AP coverage said Nvidia AI chips were widely used in data centers, contradicting claims that Nvidia never sold such chips.

claim: Nvidia denied having any revenue from AI chips in all filings.
text: The claim that Nvidia denied all AI-chip revenue in filings is false; public reporting and filings discuss AI-driven revenue.

claim: Nvidia denied having any revenue from AI chips in all filings.
text: Reuters coverage and public filings discuss Nvidia revenue linked to AI chips, contradicting claims of zero AI-chip revenue.

claim: Nvidia has zero demand for AI data-center chips according to all reports.
text: AP coverage says demand for Nvidia AI data-center chips remained strong, so claims of zero demand are false.

claim: Nvidia has zero demand for AI data-center chips according to all reports.
text: Reuters reported strong demand for Nvidia AI data-center chips, directly contradicting claims that demand was zero across all reports.

claim: Reuters reported that no AI chips were sold globally in 2026.
text: Reuters reported strong global demand and sales of AI chips in 2026, contradicting claims that no AI chips were sold.

claim: Reuters reported that no AI chips were sold globally in 2026.
text: AP coverage described active global AI-chip sales in 2026, not zero sales.

claim: Reuters reported US diplomats were directed to push back on strict data-sovereignty initiatives.
text: Reuters reported U.S. policy teams and diplomats pushed back on strict data-localization and sovereignty requirements.

claim: US policy teams debated localization and sovereignty requirements for data platforms.
text: AP coverage said U.S. policy teams debated localization and sovereignty requirements for data platforms and cross-border data rules.

claim: US policy teams debated localization and sovereignty requirements for data platforms.
text: Reuters reported U.S. policy teams debated localization and sovereignty requirements for data platforms as part of broader cross-border data policy disputes.

claim: Reuters covered policy pressure around cross-border data handling in 2026.
text: Reuters coverage in 2026 described policy pressure around cross-border data handling, localization and sovereignty rules.

claim: Reuters covered debates around data localization.
text: Reuters covered ongoing debates around data localization and sovereignty requirements.

claim: Pentagon asked major contractors about exposure to Anthropic services.
text: Reuters reported Pentagon-related inquiries about contractor exposure to major AI providers, including Anthropic services.

claim: Pentagon asked major contractors about exposure to Anthropic services.
text: AP reported defense organizations asked major contractors about operational exposure to external AI vendors such as Anthropic.

claim: Every defense contractor fully replaced human analysts with one chatbot.
text: No trusted source shows every defense contractor replaced human analysts with one chatbot; the claim is false and exaggerated.

claim: Every defense contractor fully replaced human analysts with one chatbot.
text: Reuters coverage of defense AI adoption does not say every contractor replaced analysts with one chatbot; the claim is false.

claim: All scientific institutions confirmed the moon is made of cheese.
text: Scientific institutions have not confirmed that the moon is made of cheese; the statement is false.

claim: All scientific institutions confirmed the moon is made of cheese.
text: Fact-checkers classify the claim that the moon is made of cheese as false.

claim: Reuters confirmed teleportation devices are deployed in every city.
text: Reuters did not confirm teleportation devices in every city; the claim is false and unsupported by trusted evidence.

claim: Reuters confirmed teleportation devices are deployed in every city.
text: Fact-check sources say there is no credible evidence that teleportation devices are deployed in cities.

claim: Reuters says Google search in EU has been permanently disabled.
text: AP coverage does not say Google search was permanently disabled in the EU; reporting focuses on search experiment changes instead.

claim: Google announced all competitor links will be banned globally.
text: Reuters coverage of search ranking experiments does not say Google banned all competitor links globally; that claim is false.

claim: Reuters mentioned geopolitical implications of model access among chip vendors.
text: Reuters discussed geopolitical implications of model access, export controls and competition among major chip vendors.

claim: Reuters mentioned geopolitical implications of model access among chip vendors.
text: AP reported geopolitical tension around AI models, chips and access to advanced compute vendors.

claim: Reuters discussed antitrust risks related to search ranking experiments in the EU.
text: Reuters discussed antitrust risks tied to search ranking experiments and product changes in the EU.

claim: EU antitrust pressure influenced search product experiments according to Reuters coverage.
text: AP coverage likewise described EU antitrust pressure influencing search-product experiments.

claim: All verified media confirmed that physics has been replaced by magic.
text: Trusted scientific institutions do not say physics has been replaced by magic; the claim is false.

claim: All verified media confirmed that physics has been replaced by magic.
text: Fact-check coverage treats claims that magic replaced physics as false and unsupported.
